GEM Content Engine — License
=============================

This file is the generic license summary shipped inside every buyer ZIP.
Your unique license key, order ID, and tier are in your purchase receipt
email (and in your Gumroad library at gumroad.com/library).

Reference your license key when contacting support — it confirms your
support eligibility and tier.

License grant
-------------
Your purchase of GEM Content Engine grants you a perpetual, worldwide,
non-exclusive, non-transferable license to:

  - Use the product for personal and commercial content creation
  - Modify the single HTML file for your own internal use
  - Receive lifetime updates within the v1.x major version
  - Use the output for your own clients, brands, and products

Founder's Edition (first 100 buyers) includes a commercial-use license.

Restrictions
------------
You may not:

  - Redistribute, resell, sublicense, or share the gem.html file
    with anyone outside your purchased seat count
  - Strip or alter the product's branding without an active
    white-label license (reserved for future tiers)
  - Reverse-engineer the product to clone it commercially
  - Use the product to generate illegal content, harassment,
    or content designed to commit fraud

Your output, your ownership
---------------------------
You own everything you create with the product. GEM has no server.
We never see your prompts, scripts, or generated assets.

Third-party AI providers
------------------------
The product talks to AI providers you choose: Ollama (local), OpenAI,
Anthropic, or OpenRouter. Each has its own terms. You're responsible
for using those providers in accordance with their terms.

Refunds
-------
14-day no-questions-asked refund on Founder's Edition and Builder tiers,
processed through the same checkout platform you used. See the live Terms
of Service for the full policy.

Full terms
----------
The authoritative, current version of these terms is published at:

    https://thegeminfo.com/terms.html

Privacy
-------
GEM runs 100% locally on Ollama mode. In cloud mode, your prompts go
directly from your browser to the provider you chose — GEM has no
intermediary server. Full privacy policy:

    https://thegeminfo.com/privacy.html
